Questions women actually ask

Can menopause really change vaginal odor?

Yes. Lower estrogen can alter vaginal tissues and increase vaginal pH. That can change odor and may also increase susceptibility to irritation or infection.

How long should I try it?

Reviewers reported very different timelines, ranging from one or two days to several weeks. Follow the product label and do not assume immediate results.

Can it cause side effects?

Negative reviews you supplied mentioned rash, acne, headaches, gastrointestinal effects, heart palpitations, anxiety, and no benefit. Stop use and seek medical advice if you experience a concerning reaction.

Will this treat an infection?

No. A probiotic supplement should not replace evaluation or prescribed treatment for bacterial vaginosis, yeast infection, urinary infection, or an STI.

What if the odor is fishy or rotten?

Persistent fishy or rotten odor can indicate an infection or another medical issue and should be evaluated rather than masked.

Is every review positive?

No. The review set includes women who reported no improvement and others who reported adverse effects. This page includes those limitations rather than presenting the product as guaranteed.

Do not ignore warning signs

Seek medical care for persistent fishy or rotten odor, fever, unusual bleeding, pelvic pain, painful urination, major itching or burning, swelling, rash, sores, or unusual discharge. A supplement should not delay diagnosis or treatment.
